units.title: 男家占女以财为用，女家占男以官为用，代占同断；官有生扶、财爻旺相，即许成婚

rule.yi: 占婚姻：男家占女家，用妻财爻；女家占男家，用官鬼爻；父母、亲戚朋友代占也一样。官鬼有生有扶，或者妻财旺相，就可以答应成婚。
rule.en: In a marriage divination, when the man's side asks about the woman take the Wealth line as the Subject, and when the woman's side asks about the man take the Pressure line; parents, relatives and friends divining on their behalf are the same. If the Pressure line is supported, or the Wealth line is strong, the marriage may be granted.

zh: 觉子曰：男家占女，以财为用；
女家占男，以官为用；
不拘父母亲朋代占，悉皆同之。
用官者，官有生扶；
用财者，财爻旺相，即许成婚。
yi: 觉子说：男家占女家，以妻财爻为用神；
女家占男家，以官鬼爻为用神；
不管是父母、亲戚朋友代占，全都一样。
用官鬼的，要官鬼有生有扶；
用妻财的，要财爻旺相，就许可成婚。
en: Juezi says: when the man's family divines about the woman, Wealth is the Subject;
when the woman's family divines about the man, Pressure is the Subject;
whether parents, relatives or friends divine on their behalf, all are the same.
Where Pressure is the Subject, it must be supported and helped;
where Wealth is the Subject, the Wealth line must be strong, and then the marriage may be granted.

units.title: 都说财动伤克父母，财旺一样能克：先要财官旺相得吉卦，再另占一卦看妨不妨父母

rule.yi: 这门婚事妨不妨父母：古书只说妻财发动才伤克父母，觉子驳它——春天占，财爻是木、父母爻是土，当令的木一定克得住休囚的土，旺和动一样能伤。他的办法是分占：先要财、官旺相，得到吉卦，再单独占一卦，问这门婚事会不会妨克父母。
rule.en: Whether the marriage harms the parents: the old books say only a moving Wealth line harms and controls the parents, and Juezi rejects this; in a spring divination Wealth is Wood and the Resource line is Earth, and Wood in season surely controls resting Earth, so strength harms just as movement does. His method is to divine separately: first Wealth and Pressure must be strong and the hexagram auspicious, then cast a separate hexagram on whether the marriage harms or controls the parents.

zh: 今按古今诸书，又以财旺伤克父母，余不知宜财之旺而为吉乎？
抑宜财不旺而为吉乎？
或曰：《黄金策》云：翁姑不睦，皆因妻位交重；
《海底眼》云：财动丧双亲；
《易冒》亦云：妻财动，父母参商。
俱以财动则伤克父母，未说旺也。
余曰：动则能伤父母，旺则不能伤乎？
假令春天占卦，财爻属木，谓之女命旺而可取，但父母爻定然属土，如此当权得令之财爻，有不克休囚之父母爻者乎？
何必曰动？
殊不知昔人言动而不言旺者，正虑后人驳议，故讳言其旺，不得已而言动也，岂知亦被看破耶？
或曰：据尔之论，则何以为法？
余曰：今分占之法也，先要财官旺相，既得吉卦，再占妨克父母否，是其法也。
yi: 现在按古今各书，又说财旺会伤克父母，我不知道财爻到底该旺才吉利呢？
还是财爻不旺才吉利呢？
有人说：《黄金策》讲：公婆不和，都是因为妻财爻重叠发动；
《海底眼》讲：财爻发动，会失去双亲；
《易冒》也讲：妻财爻动，父母就成了参星和商星，彼此见不到面（不和睦、要分离）。
这几本都是说财爻动了就伤克父母，没有说旺。
我说：动了能伤父母，旺了就不能伤吗？
假如春天占卦，财爻属木，说这是女方命旺、可以娶，但父母爻必定属土，这样当权得令的财爻，有不克那休囚的父母爻的吗？
何必说「动」呢？
殊不知前人只说动而不说旺，正是担心后人驳斥，所以避讳说旺，不得已才说动，哪知道也被看破了呢？
有人问：照你的说法，那用什么办法呢？
我说：现在用分占的办法：先要财、官旺相，得到吉卦以后，再另占一卦问妨不妨克父母，这就是办法。
en: Now, going by the books old and new, it is also said that a strong Wealth line harms and controls the parents; I do not know whether it is good for Wealth to be strong,
or good for Wealth not to be strong?
Someone says: the Huangjin Ce states: when the parents-in-law are at odds it is all because the Wealth line is doubled and moving;
the Haidi Yan states: when Wealth moves, both parents are lost;
the Yi Mao also says: when the Wealth line moves, the parents become like the stars Shen and Shang, never to meet (estranged and parted).
All of them say that a moving Wealth line harms and controls the parents; none says a strong one does.
I say: if it moves it can harm the parents, but if it is strong it cannot?

Suppose the divination is made in spring and the Wealth line is Wood; we call it a strong lot for the woman and worth taking, yet the Resource line, the parents, must be Earth: a Wealth line holding power and in season like this, is there any that does not control a resting, trapped Resource line?
Why must it be said to be 'moving'?

It is not realized that the men of old spoke of moving and not of strength precisely because they feared later objections, so they avoided mentioning strength and said 'moving' only under compulsion; who would have thought this too would be seen through?
Someone says: by your argument, then what is the method?

I say: the method now is to divine separately: first Wealth and Pressure must be strong and the hexagram auspicious, and then divine again whether it harms or controls the parents; that is the method.

units.title: 《黄金策》《易冒》既以应爻为妻，又以应爻为女家父母：两说并用，贤良之女都出自富贵之家，荒谬

rule.yi: 觉子驳一种推法：把应爻当作妻，要它旺相才是贤良的女子；同时又把应爻当作女家的父母，旺相就是富贵人家、休囚就是贫寒人家。两个说法一起用，就推出「贤良的女子都出自富贵人家」，说不通——一个爻不能同时担当两个角色。
rule.en: Juezi attacks a way of reading in which the Other line is both the wife (she must be strong to be a virtuous woman) and the woman's parents (strong means a rich family, resting means a poor one). Used together, the two readings lead to 'every virtuous woman comes from a rich family', which is absurd: one line cannot carry two roles at once.

zh: 又按《黄金策》专以应为妻位，《易冒》亦以应为妻，欲其旺相，乃为发福贤良之女。
又以应为女家父母，谓之应爻旺相，必是富贵之家；
应若休囚，必主贫寒之宅。
执此论之，则旺相贤良之女，必皆出于富贵之家耶？
种种悖谬，千百年来何竟无一人拈出。
yi: 又按《黄金策》专门把应当作妻的位置，《易冒》也把应当作妻，要它旺相，才是能发福的贤良女子。
又把应当作女家的父母，说应爻旺相，一定是富贵人家；
应爻如果休囚，一定是贫寒的人家。
照这个说法推下去，那么旺相的贤良女子，就必定都出自富贵人家了吗？
种种荒谬，千百年来怎么竟然没有一个人指出来。
en: Again, the Huangjin Ce takes the Other line alone as the wife's place, and the Yi Mao too takes the Other as the wife, wanting it strong so that she is a virtuous woman who brings good fortune.
And they take the Other as the woman's parents, saying that if the Other line is strong it must be a rich and noble family;
if the Other line is resting and trapped, it must be a poor and cold household.
Holding to this argument, must every strong, virtuous woman then come from a rich and noble family?
All these absurdities: how is it that in a thousand years not one person has pointed them out?

units.title: 男卜女姻财要旺，女占男配鬼宜兴：代占以应爻为对方家，自占以应爻为女身；财为重，应为附和

rule.yi: 男方占，妻财要旺；女方占，官鬼要兴旺。代占的：男家占女，用财爻，应爻算女家；女家占男，用官鬼，应爻算男家。财、官要旺相，动了要化出吉象；应爻不该空、破，也不该克世（女家代占的应爻还不该入墓、绝）。男子自占娶妻：也用财爻，应爻兼算女子本人；财爻和应爻生世、持世、合世都吉，最忌破、墓、绝、空；财旺生世而应爻破空还可取，应爻生世而财爻破绝就不要求。野鹤补一句：财、应一起来生合世更吉；大体上财为重，应只是附和。
rule.en: A man divining wants Wealth strong; a woman divining wants Pressure flourishing. For a divination on someone's behalf: when the man's family asks about the woman, use the Wealth line and take the Other line as her family; when the woman's family asks about the man, use the Pressure line and take the Other line as his family. Wealth or Pressure should be strong, and if it moves it should change into good; the Other line should not be Void or broken, nor control the Self line (in the woman's family's divination it should not be in a tomb or extinguished either). A man divining his own wife-to-be also uses the Wealth line and takes the Other line as the woman herself; Wealth and the Other line are good when they generate, hold or combine with the Self line, and most to be feared when broken, entombed, extinguished or Void; strong Wealth generating the Self while the Other line is broken or Void can still be taken, but if the Other line generates the Self while Wealth is broken or extinguished, do not seek it. Yehe adds: it is better still when Wealth and the Other line both come to generate or combine with the Self line; in general Wealth carries the weight and the Other line only follows along.

zh: 男卜女姻财要旺，女占男配鬼宜兴。
男家代占女，专以财为用神，以应爻为女家；
财宜旺相，动而化吉；
应爻不宜空破及克世爻。
女家代占男，专以官为用神，以应爻为男家；
宜官星旺相、动而化吉；
应爻不宜空破墓绝，不宜克世。
男子自占妻者，亦以财爻为用，兼以应爻为女身；
财与应爻，皆以生世、持世、合世为吉，最忌破墓绝空；
财旺生身，应值破空，亦取；
应爻生世，财爻破绝，休求。
yi: 男子卜女方的姻缘，妻财要旺；女子占男方的婚配，官鬼宜兴旺。
男家代占女方，专用妻财爻为用神，把应爻当作女家；
财爻宜旺相，动了要化出吉象；
应爻不该空、破，也不该克世爻。
女家代占男方，专用官鬼爻为用神，把应爻当作男家；
官鬼爻宜旺相，动了要化出吉象；
应爻不该空、破、入墓、绝，也不该克世。
男子自己占娶妻的，也用财爻为用神，同时把应爻当作女子本人；
财爻和应爻，都以生世、持世、合世为吉，最忌破、墓、绝、空；
财旺而生扶世爻，应爻逢破、空，也可以取；
应爻生世，但财爻破、绝，就不要求了。
en: A man divining a woman's match wants Wealth strong; a woman divining a man's match wants Pressure to flourish.
When the man's family divines for the woman's side, take Wealth alone as the Subject and the Other line as the woman's family;
Wealth should be strong, and if it moves it should change into something good;
the Other line should not be Void or broken, nor control the Self line.
When the woman's family divines for the man's side, take Pressure alone as the Subject and the Other line as the man's family;
the Pressure line should be strong, and if it moves it should change into something good;
the Other line should not be Void, broken, entombed or extinguished, nor control the Self line.
A man divining his own wife-to-be also takes the Wealth line as the Subject, and takes the Other line as the woman herself as well;
Wealth and the Other line are both good when they generate, hold or combine with the Self line, and most to be feared when broken, entombed, extinguished or Void;
if Wealth is strong and generates the Self line while the Other line meets a break or Void, still take it;
if the Other line generates the Self but the Wealth line is broken or extinguished, do not seek it.

zh: 野鹤曰：财爻、应爻同来生合世者，更吉。
大抵以财为重，应为附和耳。
《黄金策》曰：应为百岁之妻，重应而不重财，谬也。
yi: 野鹤说：财爻和应爻一起来生世、合世的，更吉。
大体上以财爻为重，应爻只是附和罢了。
《黄金策》说：应是百岁之妻，看重应爻而不看重财爻，这是错的。
en: Yehe says: when the Wealth line and the Other line both come to generate or combine with the Self line, it is even better.
In general Wealth carries the weight, and the Other line only follows along.
The Huangjin Ce says the Other line is the wife of a hundred years, stressing the Other line and not Wealth; this is wrong.

zh: 世是一身之本，应为百岁之妻。
若见相生相合，必然夫唱妇随。
yi: 世是自身的根本，应是百岁相伴的妻。
如果看到相生相合，必定夫唱妇随。
en: The Self line is the root of one's own person; the Other line is the wife of a hundred years.
If they generate or combine with each other, the husband leads and the wife follows without fail.

dispute.yi: 「应为百岁之妻」这句在《黄金策》「身命」章（占一生的那一章）的注里，不在它的婚姻章里。野鹤驳的是把它拿来占婚：重应而不重财是错的。夫妇章的正文替《黄金策》解释了为什么那样定（身命章一个卦要断六亲，财爻另有用处），也说占妻以财为重、应次之。两边都承认要兼看财爻，争的是谁为主。
dispute.en: The line 'the Other line is the wife of a hundred years' stands in the commentary of the Huangjin Ce's chapter on one's person and fate, not in its marriage chapter. Yehe attacks using it for marriage: stressing the Other line and not Wealth is wrong. The main text of the Zengshan Buyi's chapter on husband and wife explains why the Huangjin Ce fixed it that way (the person-and-fate chapter judges the six kin from a single hexagram, so Wealth had other work to do) and also says that in divining a wife Wealth carries the weight and the Other line comes second. Both sides agree that Wealth should be looked at as well; what they dispute is which comes first.

units.title: 以应爻为男家是死法：财官为重，世应为轻，女家占男也要财爻不失陷

rule.yi: 女家占男，用官鬼，把应爻当男家——这是古法，也是死法，断卦要活。官鬼旺相持世（婚该成）而应爻受克（男家像是不肯）时怎么断？觉子的判法：财、官为重，世、应为轻；就算是女家占男，也要财爻不失陷。男女两个人的事，财爻被回头克、又被丑土克，就生不了卯木官鬼，男女不能相合相生，婚姻即使成了也会有变。
rule.en: When the woman's family divines about the man, Pressure is the Subject and the Other line stands for the man's family; that is the old method, and a dead one, and a hexagram must be judged with flexibility. What if a strong Pressure line holds the Self line (the marriage should be made) while the Other line is controlled (the man's family seems unwilling)? Juezi's judgment: Wealth and Pressure carry the weight, the Self and Other lines matter less; even when the woman's family divines about the man, the Wealth line must not fall into ruin. The matter concerns both the man and the woman: if Wealth is controlled by what it turns into and again by Chou Earth, it cannot generate the Mao Wood Pressure, the two cannot combine or generate each other, and even if the marriage is made it will meet change.

zh: 觉子曰：女家占男，以官为用，以应爻为男家，此古法也，亦死法也，断卦之时，须宜活变。
夫所得之卦，岂皆显而易见者哉？
即如此卦，女家占男，卯木旺官持世，其婚必成，而应爻受克，又为男家不允，似此，何以决之？
要知财官为重，世应为轻，虽是女家占男，亦要财爻不致于失陷。
此—卦也，关乎男女二人，财被回头克，又逢丑土之克，如何能生卯木之官？
男女不能相合相生，婚姻虽成，亦当有变。
后果聘定于四月，未及成婚，被贼兵于四月内劫去，应巳月者，亥水逢月破也。
yi: 觉子说：女家占男方，用官鬼爻为用神，把应爻当作男家，这是古法，也是死法，断卦的时候必须活变。
所得到的卦，难道都是明摆着一看就懂的吗？
就拿这一卦来说，女家占男方，卯木旺官持世，这门婚事该成，可是应爻受克，又表示男家不答应，像这样，怎么来判定？
要知道财、官为重，世、应为轻，虽然是女家占男方，也要财爻不至于失陷。
这一卦，关系到男女两个人，财爻被回头克，又碰上丑土来克，怎么能去生卯木的官鬼？
男女不能相合相生，婚事即使成了，也该有变故。
后来果然四月订了聘，还没来得及成婚，人在四月里被贼兵劫走了，应在巳月，是因为亥水逢月破。
en: Juezi says: when the woman's family divines about the man, Pressure is the Subject and the Other line is the man's family; this is the old method, and also a dead method; in judging a hexagram one must adapt.
Are the hexagrams one obtains all plain and easy to see?

Take this very hexagram: the woman's family divines about the man; the Mao Wood Pressure line, strong, holds the Self line, so the marriage should be made, yet the Other line is controlled, which would mean the man's family refuses; in such a case, how is it decided?
Know that Wealth and Pressure carry the weight and the Self and Other lines matter less; even though it is the woman's family divining about the man, the Wealth line must not fall into ruin.
This hexagram concerns both the man and the woman: the Wealth line is controlled by what it turns into and is again controlled by the Chou Earth, so how can it generate the Mao Wood Pressure?
The man and woman cannot combine or generate each other; even if the marriage is made, there will be change.

Afterwards the betrothal was indeed settled in the fourth month, and before the wedding could take place the person was carried off by bandit soldiers within that month; it answered in the Si month because the Hai Water met a Month-break.

zh: 又如：寅月丙午日(旬空：寅卯)，女家代占婚，得“临之既济”
yi: 又例：寅月丙午日（旬空寅、卯），女家代占婚事，得临卦变既济卦。
en: Another case: Yin month, Bingwu day (void: Yin and Mao); the woman's family divined a marriage on someone's behalf and got Lin changing to Jiji.

note.yi: 觉子这段话接在「临之既济」的卦例后面，「此卦」指的就是那一卦（书里那一卦的排盘图这里不收）。原文里还有一句「居士注」，是后人加的，这里不引。
note.en: Juezi's remarks follow the case of 'Lin changing to Jiji', and 'this hexagram' means that one (its chart is not included here). The original also has a note by a 'layman' (jushi), a later addition, which is not quoted.

units.title: 财值休囚破散、官逢衰墓绝空，难成婚：财官爻忌墓绝空破，也忌动而化破化散化克化鬼；男占忌财犯，女占忌官犯，自占忌世犯

rule.yi: 妻财休囚、破、散，或官鬼衰、入墓、绝、空，都难成婚。财爻、官爻不该落墓、绝、空、破，也不该动了以后化成破、散、克、鬼——那是短命贫寒的命。男方占，忌财爻犯这些；女方占，忌官爻犯；男女自己占，忌世爻犯，勉强成婚，很快就会不和。
rule.en: If Wealth is resting, trapped, broken or scattered, or Pressure is weak, entombed, extinguished or Void, the marriage can hardly be made. Neither the Wealth line nor the Pressure line should fall into tomb, extinction, Void or break, nor move and change into a break, a scattering, a controller or Pressure: that is a fate of early death and poverty. For a man's divination, fear that the Wealth line commits these faults; for a woman's, the Pressure line; when a man or woman divines for themselves, the Self line; if the marriage is forced through, discord shows at once.

zh: 财值休囚破散，终非举案之俦；
官逢衰墓绝空，难遂齐眉之愿。
财爻官爻，不宜墓绝空破，又不宜动而化破化散、化克化鬼，乃夭折贫寒之命。
男占，忌财爻犯之；
女占，忌官爻犯之；
男女自占，世爻忌犯，勉强成婚，参商立见。
yi: 财爻落在休囚破散，终究不是能举案齐眉的一对；
官鬼爻逢衰、墓、绝、空，难遂举案齐眉的心愿。
财爻、官爻，不该落墓、绝、空、破，又不该动了以后化成破、化成散、化成克、化成鬼，那是短命贫寒的命。
男方占，忌财爻犯这些毛病；
女方占，忌官爻犯；
男女自己占，忌世爻犯，勉强成婚，很快就会不和睦。
en: Wealth resting, trapped, broken or scattered will never be a couple of mutual respect ('raising the tray to the brow');
Pressure meeting decline, tomb, extinction or Void can hardly fulfil the wish for that mutual respect.

The Wealth and Pressure lines should not fall into tomb, extinction, Void or break, nor move and change into a break, a scattering, a controller or Pressure; that is a fate of early death and poverty.
For a man's divination, fear that the Wealth line commits these faults;
for a woman's, fear that the Pressure line does;
when a man or woman divines for themselves, fear that the Self line does; if the marriage is forced through, discord shows at once.

units.title: 世静而空亡、世动化退神，终成空：动而空的等实空之月日必成，静而空终不成；世动化进必成、化退难成；应爻同断

rule.yi: 世爻静而落空亡，或者动了变成退神，终究要失望。世爻动而落空的，到填实空亡的月份、日子一定成；静而落空的，终究不成。世爻动：化成进神一定成，化成退神难成。应爻静而空、破，或者化成退神，也照这个推。
rule.en: A Self line that is still and Void, or that moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, ends in disappointment. If it moves and is Void, it succeeds in the month or day that fills the Void; if it is still and Void, it never succeeds. If the Self line moves, changing into an Advancing spirit it surely succeeds, changing into a Retreating spirit it is hard to accomplish. A still Other line that is Void or broken, or that changes into a Retreating spirit, is judged the same way.

zh: 世静空亡动化退，终须失望。
动而空者，实空之月日必成；
静而空者，终不成也；
世动，化进必就，化退难成。
应爻静而空破，及化退神，亦同此推。
yi: 世爻静而落空亡，或者动了变成退神，终究要失望。
动而落空的，到填实空亡的月份日子一定成；
静而落空的，终究不成；
世爻动，化成进神一定成，化成退神难成。
应爻静而空、破，以及化成退神，也照这个推。
en: A Self line that is still and Void, or that moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, ends in disappointment.
If it moves and is Void, it succeeds in the month or day that fills the Void;
if it is still and Void, it never succeeds;
if the Self line moves, changing into an Advancing spirit it surely succeeds, changing into a Retreating spirit it is hard to accomplish.
A still Other line that is Void or broken, or changes into a Retreating spirit, is judged the same way.

units.title: 应静旬空财化进，是早有的良缘：应空则对方不实，动而化退必有反悔；财动化进生世，虽退悔终是良缘

rule.yi: 应爻静而旬空、财爻化成进神，是早就有的好姻缘。应爻空，是对方不踏实；如果应爻动了又化成退神，对方必有反悔的心。如果财爻动、化成进神而来生世，虽然会有退悔，终究是好姻缘。世爻、应爻动了又逢破，也应在破被填实的时候。
rule.en: A still Other line in the Void of its ten-day cycle with Wealth changing into an Advancing spirit is a good match long fated. If the Other line is Void, the other party is not sincere; if it moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, they surely have thoughts of going back on it. If Wealth moves, changes into an Advancing spirit and generates the Self line, then although there is withdrawal and regret, it is in the end a good match. If the Self and Other lines move and are broken, it too answers at the time the break becomes real.

zh: 应静旬空财化进，夙有良缘。
应空他人不实，若动而化退，必有反悔之心。
若得财动化进而生世者，虽见退悔，终是良缘；
若世应动而破者，亦应实破之时。
yi: 应爻静而旬空，财爻化成进神，是早就有的好姻缘。
应爻空，是对方不踏实；如果动了又化成退神，对方必有反悔的心。
如果财爻动了化成进神而来生世，虽然会有退悔，终究是好姻缘；
如果世爻、应爻动而逢破，也应在破被填实的时候。
en: A still Other line in the Void of its ten-day cycle with Wealth changing into an Advancing spirit: a good match long fated.
If the Other line is Void, the other party is not sincere; if it moves and changes into a Retreating spirit, they surely have thoughts of going back on it.
If Wealth moves, changes into an Advancing spirit and generates the Self line, then although there is withdrawal and regret, it is in the end a good match;
if the Self and Other lines move and are broken, it too answers at the time the break becomes real.

units.title: 世应都空徒费力，卦逢反吟事难成；野鹤：空而逢旺、财鬼相生，先不允后终成

rule.yi: 世爻、应爻都空，是白费力气；卦变成反吟，翻来覆去难成。野鹤补充：如果是空而逢旺，财爻和官鬼互相生，起先虽然不答应，后来终究还是成。
rule.en: With the Self and Other lines both Void, effort is wasted; a hexagram that turns into a Reversed Chant flips back and forth and is hard to accomplish. Yehe adds: if the Void meets strength and Wealth and Pressure generate each other, although at first it is refused, in the end it still succeeds.

zh: 世应皆空徒费力，反吟多变事难成。
世应俱空，事无准实；
反吟卦变，翻覆难成。
yi: 世爻应爻都空，是白费力气；反吟多变，事难成。
世应都空，事情没有准头、不踏实；
反吟的卦变，翻来覆去难成。
en: With both the Self and Other lines Void, effort is wasted; a Reversed Chant is full of change and the matter is hard to accomplish.
With the Self and Other both Void, the matter has nothing solid to it;
a Reversed Chant change flips back and forth and is hard to accomplish.

zh: 野鹤曰：倘得空而逢旺，财鬼相生，先虽不允，后终还成。
yi: 野鹤说：如果是空，但空得逢旺，财、鬼互相生，起先虽然不答应，后来终究还是成。
en: Yehe says: if it is Void but the Void meets strength, and Wealth and Pressure generate each other, although at first it is refused, in the end it still succeeds.

units.title: 男占，兄弟持世或发动是伤妻阻隔之神，婚必难成、已成必刑伤；觉子验过：兄持世而财爻合世必成，世临兄化出财也成

rule.yi: 男方占，兄弟爻持世或者发动，是伤妻、阻隔的神，婚事一定难成；已经成了的婚姻遇到这种情况，免不了刑伤。觉子验证过的：兄弟爻持世但财爻合世的，一定成；世爻临兄弟爻而变出财爻的，也成。
rule.en: In a man's divination, a Peer line on the Self line or a moving Peer line is the spirit that harms the wife and obstructs, and the marriage will be hard to make; a marriage already made that meets this cannot escape injury. What Juezi has verified: with a Peer line on the Self line but the Wealth line combining with the Self, it surely succeeds; if the Self line is on a Peer and changes into Wealth, it also succeeds.

zh: 男占兮，兄动卦中非配偶。
兄持世，或兄爻发动，乃伤妻阻隔之神，婚必难成；
已成之婚遇此者，刑伤不免。
yi: 男子占啊，兄弟爻在卦中发动，就不是配偶。
兄弟爻持世，或者兄弟爻发动，是伤妻、阻隔的神，婚事一定难成；
已经成了的婚姻遇到这种情况，免不了刑伤。
en: For a man's divination: when the Peer line moves in the hexagram, she is not the mate.
A Peer line on the Self, or a moving Peer line, is the spirit that harms the wife and obstructs, and the marriage will be hard to make;
a marriage already made that meets this cannot escape injury.

zh: 觉子曰：予得验者，兄持世，财爻合世，必成；
世临兄而化出财爻者，亦成。
yi: 觉子说：我验证过的，兄弟爻持世，但财爻合世的，一定成；
世爻临兄弟爻而变出财爻的，也成。
en: Juezi says: what I have verified is that with the Peer line on the Self line but the Wealth line combining with the Self, it surely succeeds;
if the Self line is on a Peer and changes into a Wealth line, it also succeeds.

units.title: 女占男，官爻持世是良缘：官星持世、合世、生世且旺相，姻缘必成；子孙持世或发动克夫；官星重叠主两度新人

rule.yi: 女方占男方，官鬼爻持世是好姻缘。不宜子孙持世，也不宜子孙发动：子孙是克夫的神，没成的成不了，已成的会伤夫再嫁。只有官星持世、合世、生世、旺相的，姻缘一定成，还能举案齐眉。卦中官星重叠的，也主嫁两次。
rule.en: When a woman divines about a man, a Pressure line on the Self line is a good match. An Output line should not hold the Self line or move, for Output is the spirit that controls the husband: a match not yet made will not be made, and one already made will harm the husband and she will marry again. Only where the Pressure star holds, combines with or generates the Self, and is strong, is the match certain and even one of mutual respect. If the Pressure star is doubled in the hexagram, that too means two marriages.

zh: 女卜兮，官爻持世是良缘。
女占男，不宜子孙持世，子孙发动，子孙乃克夫之神，未成者不成，已成者伤夫再嫁。
惟官星持世、合世、生世、旺相者，不且姻缘必就，犹许举案齐眉；
卦中官星重叠者，亦主两度新人。
yi: 女子占啊，官爻持世是好姻缘。
女子占男方，不宜子孙持世，也不宜子孙发动，子孙是克夫的神，没成的成不了，已成的会伤夫而再嫁。
只有官星持世、合世、生世、旺相的，不但姻缘一定成，还能够举案齐眉；
卦中官星重叠的，也主要嫁两次。
en: For a woman's divination: a Pressure line on the Self is a good match.

When a woman divines about a man, it is not good for an Output line to hold the Self or to move, for Output is the spirit that controls the husband: what is not yet made will not be made, and what is made will harm the husband and she will marry again.
Only where the Pressure star holds, combines with or generates the Self, and is strong, is the match not only certain but even one of mutual respect;
if the Pressure star is doubled in the hexagram, that too means two marriages.

note.yi: 原文「不且姻缘必就」的「不且」，读起来应是「不但」的误字；这里照录原文，译文按「不但」译。
note.en: The original reads 'bu qie', which looks like a slip for 'bu dan' ('not only'); it is kept as written and translated as 'not only'.

units.title: 财官世应互相冲刑，夫妻反目：妻占夫而子孙持世，子孙本是克夫之神，有相生才不伤克，但已不和；应爻逢合，丈夫有外遇，终致生离

rule.yi: 财爻、官爻、世爻、应爻互相冲刑，夫妻就会反目。书中的例子（妻子占夫妻不和，将来能不能和好）：妻占夫不宜子孙持世，因为子孙是克夫的神；这卦幸好寅木、子水互相生，伤克不了，所以是不和而不是死别；又因为应爻代表丈夫，应爻逢子丑合，丈夫已经有了外遇。结果虽然不至于死别，生离是一定的。
rule.en: When Wealth, Pressure, the Self and the Other lines clash with and punish each other, husband and wife fall out. The book's case (a wife divining whether the couple, now at odds, will be reconciled): in a wife's divination it is bad for an Output line to hold the Self, because Output is the spirit that controls the husband; here, luckily, Yin Wood and Zi Water generate each other so no harm is done, and the result is discord rather than death; and because the Other line stands for the husband and meets a Zi-Chou combination, the husband already has another attachment. The couple would not part by death, but parting alive was certain.

zh: 财官世应冲刑，夫妻反目。
yi: 财爻、官爻、世爻、应爻互相冲刑，夫妻就反目成仇。
en: Wealth, Pressure, the Self and the Other lines clashing and punishing each other: husband and wife fall out.

zh: 如曾有妇人，于巳月乙亥日(旬空：申酉)，占夫妻不和，将来和好否？
得“需之大过”
yi: 例：有一位妇人，在巳月乙亥日（旬空申、酉），占夫妻不和，将来能不能和好？
得需卦变大过卦。
en: Case: a woman, in the Si month on a Yihai day (void: Shen and You), divined that husband and wife were at odds and asked whether they would be reconciled.
She got Xu changing to Daguo.

zh: 断曰：妻占夫，不宜子孙持世，子孙乃克夫之神也。
今幸寅木子水相生，不能伤克，所以不和，又兼应爻为夫，应逢子丑作合，尊夫已有外遇，水木相生，两人情如蜜矣。
yi: 断语：妻子占丈夫，不宜子孙持世，子孙是克夫的神。
现在幸好寅木、子水相生，伤克不了，所以是不和；又兼应爻是丈夫，应爻逢子丑作合，你的丈夫已有外遇，水木相生，两个人情意如蜜了。
en: Judgment: when a wife divines about her husband, an Output line should not hold the Self, for Output is the spirit that controls the husband.

Now, luckily, Yin Wood and Zi Water generate each other so no harm is done, so the result is discord; moreover the Other line is the husband, and it meets a Zi-Chou combination: your husband already has another attachment, Water and Wood generating each other, and the two are as sweet as honey.

zh: 余曰：汝夫妇不是姻缘，虽则不能死别，生离必矣。
果于次年寅月休其妻，六月娶其情好者矣！
yi: 我说：你们夫妇不是姻缘，虽然不至于死别，生离是一定的。
果然在第二年寅月他休了妻子，六月娶了他相好的那个人！
en: I said: you and your husband are not a fated match; although it will not be a parting by death, parting alive is certain.
Indeed in the Yin month of the next year he divorced his wife, and in the sixth month he married the one he was fond of!

note.yi: 例中的排盘图这里不收；原文这一行末尾有一句「（注：虎易版为己亥日）」，是今人加的，不引。
note.en: The chart of the case is not included; the line ends with a note '(note: the Huyi edition has Jihai as the day)', a modern addition, which is not quoted.

units.title: 旺相爻逢六合，彼此同心：六冲变六合久必成；六冲卦无财官两旺切不可成；六合变六冲先允后变，已成也拆

rule.yi: 爻逢六合，占婚最合适，还要财、官旺相才吉；男子最忌财爻逢破、墓，女子要防官星被克、逢绝。六冲变成六合的更吉：求婚的眼下不答应，时间久了一定成；已经成了却不和睦的，最终会和美。只忌六冲卦：如果没有财、官两旺，千万不可成婚，即使勉强成了，不是死别就是生离。六合变成六冲，先答应后改变，已经成的到头来也会拆散。
rule.en: When the lines meet a Six-combine, it is most suitable for a marriage divination, and it is good only if Wealth and Pressure are strong too; a man fears Wealth meeting a break or tomb, a woman guards against the Pressure position being controlled or extinguished. A Six-clash changing into a Six-combine is better still: for one seeking a marriage, although refused for now, it will be made in time; for a couple already wed but at odds, they will in the end be at peace. Only a Six-clash hexagram is to be feared: unless both Wealth and Pressure are strong, on no account make the match, and even if it is forced through it ends either in death or in parting alive. A Six-combine changing into a Six-clash is first agreed and then changed, and one already wed will in the end be split up.

zh: 旺相爻逢六合，彼此同心。
爻逢六合，占婚最宜，更要财官旺相为吉，男忌财逢破墓，女防官位克绝。
六冲变六合者尤吉，求婚者，目下不允，久必成之，已成不睦者，终须和美。
惟忌六冲卦，若无财官两旺，切不可成，即使勉就，若非死别，即是生离；
六合变六冲，先允而后更张，已成者而终拆枕。
yi: 旺相的爻逢六合，彼此同心。
爻遇六合，占婚最合适，还要财爻、官爻旺相才吉，男子最忌财爻逢破、墓，女子要防官位被克、逢绝。
六冲变成六合的更吉，求婚的，眼下不答应，时间久了一定成；已经成了但不和睦的，最终会和美。
只忌六冲卦，如果没有财、官两旺，千万不可成婚，即使勉强成了，不是死别，就是生离；
六合变成六冲，先是答应，后来改变，已经成的到头来也会拆散。
en: Strong lines meeting a Six-combine: the two are of one heart.

Lines meeting a Six-combine are most suitable for a marriage divination, and it is good only if Wealth and Pressure are strong too; a man fears Wealth meeting a break or tomb, a woman guards against the Pressure position being controlled or extinguished.

A Six-clash changing into a Six-combine is better still: for one seeking a marriage, although refused for now, it will be made in time; for a couple already wed but at odds, they will in the end be at peace and in harmony.
Only a Six-clash hexagram is to be feared: unless both Wealth and Pressure are strong, on no account make the match; even if it is forced through, it ends either in death or in parting alive;
a Six-combine changing into a Six-clash: first agreed, then changed; one already wed will in the end be split up.

units.title: 咸临节泰吉、暌革解离凶的古说不可执：仍用财官世应断；有疑再占一卦，以后一卦为准

rule.yi: 古人把咸、临、节、泰当作占婚的吉卦，把暌、革、解、离当作凶卦。觉子引《易冒》：得咸、临、节、泰，只要不遇到合冲、变冲，即使财官衰陷也不算凶；暌、革、解、离是凶兆，用神齐全也不算吉。觉子自己试了：得泰卦，可是兄弟持世、财爻月破旬空又被世爻克、日辰刑，他不敢拿别人的婚姻大事去试；让人再占一卦得坤卦，六冲大凶，才知道前面的泰卦不是吉，还是以财、官、世、应来断为对。有疑问不要死执古法，以再占的卦为准：后卦吉就按吉断，后卦凶就按凶推。
rule.en: The ancients took Xian, Lin, Jie and Tai as auspicious hexagrams for marriage and Kui, Ge, Xie and Li as ill ones. Juezi quotes the Yi Mao: with Xian, Lin, Jie or Tai, unless it meets a combination-clash or a change into a clash, it is not ill even if Wealth and Pressure are weak and fallen; Kui, Ge, Xie and Li are ill omens, and it is not auspicious even if the Subject is complete. Juezi tried it himself: he obtained Tai, but with a Peer line on the Self, the Wealth line under a Month-break and Void and also controlled by the Self line and punished by the Day, and he dared not test it on someone's great matter of marriage; when the person divined again and got Kun, a Six-clash of great ill, he knew the earlier Tai was not auspicious, and that judging by Wealth, Pressure, Self and Other remains right. When in doubt do not cling to the old methods; decide by the hexagram divined again: if the later one is auspicious judge it auspicious, if it is ill reckon it ill.

zh: 古用咸临节泰，忌逢暌革解离。
yi: 古人用咸、临、节、泰（为吉卦），忌遇暌、革、解、离（为凶卦）。
en: The ancients favored Xian, Lin, Jie and Tai, and feared meeting Kui, Ge, Xie and Li.

zh: 觉子曰：《易冒》云：卦得咸临节泰，若不遇合冲变冲，虽财官衰陷，随墓助伤，皆不为凶，暌革解离则为凶兆，虽用神全备而化合，亦不为吉，此言用神未胜于卦验也。
yi: 觉子说：《易冒》讲：卦得咸、临、节、泰，只要不遇到合冲、变冲，即使财、官衰弱陷落，随墓、助伤，也都不算凶；暌、革、解、离则是凶兆，即使用神齐全而化合，也不算吉，这话是说用神比不上卦名所示的应验。
en: Juezi says: the Yi Mao states: if the hexagram obtained is Xian, Lin, Jie or Tai, then unless it meets a combination-clash or a change-clash, even if Wealth and Pressure are weak and fallen, following into a tomb or aiding harm, none of this counts as ill; Kui, Ge, Xie and Li are ill omens, and even if the Subject is complete and turns into a combination it is not auspicious either; this says that the Subject does not outweigh what the hexagram itself shows.

zh: 曾于：巳月丁卯日(旬空：戌亥)，占婚于何时，得“地天泰”
yi: 曾经：巳月丁卯日（旬空戌、亥），占婚事在什么时候，得地天泰卦。
en: Once, in the Si month on a Dingmao day (void: Xu and Hai), I divined when the marriage would be, and got the hexagram Tai.

zh: 余见此卦，兄爻持世，亥财临月破旬空，子水之财，世爻克之、日辰刑之，古虽以泰卦为吉，究不敢以人之婚姻大事而试卦也。
yi: 我看这一卦，兄弟爻持世，亥水财爻逢月破又旬空，子水的财，被世爻克、被日辰刑，古人虽然把泰卦当作吉，终究不敢拿别人的婚姻大事去试这一卦。
en: Looking at this hexagram: a Peer line on the Self line; the Hai Water Wealth line under a Month-break and Void; the Zi Water Wealth controlled by the Self line and punished by the Day; although the ancients took Tai as auspicious, I dared not test this hexagram on someone's great matter of marriage.

zh: 令其再占，又得“坤卦”
yi: 让他再占一卦，又得坤卦。
en: I had him divine again, and he got the hexagram Kun.

zh: 世爻休囚为日破，亥水财爻临月破，卦遇六冲，大凶之兆，故知前得泰卦，非为吉也，仍用财官世应者为是。
然亦不可竟以为是，凡有所疑，勿执古法而断，须以再占之卦决之。
后卦吉，即以吉断，后卦凶，则以凶推，神不欺人，彼此两无误矣。
yi: 世爻休囚又被日辰冲破，亥水财爻逢月破，卦遇六冲，是大凶的兆头，所以知道前面得的泰卦并不吉，还是以财、官、世、应来断为对。
但也不可以就此认定它对，凡是有疑问的，不要死执古法去断，要用再占的卦来决定。
后面的卦吉，就按吉断；后面的卦凶，就按凶推；神不欺人，这样双方都不会错。
en: The Self line is resting and trapped and broken by the Day, the Hai Water Wealth line is under a Month-break, and the hexagram is a Six-clash, a sign of great ill; so I knew the earlier Tai was not auspicious after all, and that judging by Wealth, Pressure, Self and Other remains right.
Yet one must not take even this as certainly right: whenever in doubt, do not cling to the old methods in judging, but decide by the hexagram divined again.
If the later hexagram is auspicious, judge it auspicious; if the later hexagram is ill, reckon it ill; the spirits do not deceive, and so neither side will be mistaken.

note.yi: 《易冒》引文里「若不遇合冲变冲」没有标点，单看这一句可以有两种读法；但《易冒》自己在合冲章里给这两个词下过定义：六合的卦被日辰冲害在世应上叫合冲，卦化成六冲叫变冲（见 LY.MARRY.YM.25、LY.MARRY.YM.24，这一句原文见 LY.MARRY.YM.03），所以这里读作「合冲」和「变冲」。
note.en: The Yi Mao quotation reads 'unless it meets he chong bian chong' with no punctuation, and taken alone the sentence can be read in two ways; but the Yi Mao itself defines the two terms in its chapter on combination and clash: a six-combine hexagram whose Self or Other is clashed or harmed by the Day is a combination-clash, and a hexagram that changes into a six-clash hexagram is a change-clash (see LY.MARRY.YM.25 and LY.MARRY.YM.24, and the sentence itself at LY.MARRY.YM.03), so it is read here as 'combination-clash' and 'change-clash'.

units.title: 财化财未必两度婚，鬼化鬼难相守百年：男家占女财爻重叠旺相生合世多贤妻美妾，财化财或双娶、婢妾同来、妆奁丰；女家占男财化财生世聘礼丰厚，鬼化鬼必夫亡或反复灾非

rule.yi: 财化财，不一定是结两次婚；鬼化鬼，很难说能相守百年。《黄金策》说「财爻叠叠，重作新人」，作者屡次试过：男家占女家，财爻重叠、旺相而生合世爻的，多主有贤妻美妾；财化财的，或者应在娶两个，或者应在婢女妾室一起来，或者妻妾众多，或者嫁妆丰厚；只怕爻中兄弟动，或者日月冲克财爻，那样免不了再办喜事。女家占男家，遇到财化财、财爻重叠而生世的，聘礼一定丰厚；不宜鬼动化鬼，那样必主丈夫亡故；鬼爻重叠克世，不是争婚夺娶，就一定反复不定、有灾祸是非。男方占遇到这种情况也主有变更，克世的就该停手，世爻化鬼的更该停手。
rule.en: Wealth changing into Wealth does not necessarily mean two marriages; Pressure changing into Pressure can hardly be said to mean keeping company for a hundred years. The Huangjin Ce says 'with Wealth lines upon Wealth lines, one becomes a bridegroom anew', but the author has tried it many times: when the man's family divines about the woman and the Wealth line is doubled, strong, and generates or combines with the Self line, it mostly means a virtuous wife and a fair concubine; where Wealth changes into Wealth, it may answer as taking two brides, or a maid or concubine coming along, or many wives and concubines, or a rich dowry; only beware a moving Peer line, or the Day and Month clashing and controlling Wealth, for then the wedding candles cannot be avoided again. When the woman's family divines about the man and gets Wealth changing into Wealth, with doubled Wealth lines generating the Self, the betrothal gifts will surely be rich; it is not good if Pressure moves and changes into Pressure, which surely means the husband's death, and doubled Pressure lines controlling the Self mean, if not a fight over the marriage or a snatched bride, then surely repeated disaster and dispute. A man who meets this also faces change; where it controls the Self one should stop, and where the Self line changes into Pressure one should stop all the more.

zh: 财化财，未必婚姻两度；
鬼化鬼，难曰相守百年。
《黄金策》曰：财爻叠叠，重作新人。
余屡试之：男家占女，财爻重叠，旺相生合世爻者，多主贤妻美妾；
财化财者，或应双娶，或应婢妾同来，或应妻妾之众，或应妆奁丰厚。
惟忌爻中兄动及日月冲克财爻，花烛重重所不免耳。
女家占男，得遇财化财，财爻重叠生世者，必主百两盈门，千金作聘，不宜鬼动化鬼，必主夫亡，鬼爻重叠克世，若非争婚夺娶，定然反复灾非。
男占遇之，亦主更变，克世者，即宜止之；
世爻化鬼者，更宜止之。
yi: 财爻化出财爻，未必是婚姻两次；
鬼爻化出鬼爻，很难说能相守百年。
《黄金策》说：财爻重重叠叠，要再做一回新人。
我屡次试过：男家占女方，财爻重叠，旺相而生合世爻的，多主有贤惠的妻、漂亮的妾；
财化财的，或者应在娶两个，或者应在婢女妾室一起来，或者应在妻妾众多，或者应在嫁妆丰厚。
只怕爻中兄弟爻动，以及日月冲克财爻，那样重重的花烛就免不了了。
女家占男方，遇到财化财，财爻重叠生世的，必主聘礼百两盈门、千金下聘；不宜鬼动化鬼，那样必主丈夫亡故，鬼爻重叠克世，不是争婚夺娶，就一定反复不定、有灾祸是非。
男方占遇到这种情况，也主有变更，克世的，就该停手；
世爻化成鬼的，更该停手。
en: Wealth changing into Wealth does not necessarily mean two marriages;
Pressure changing into Pressure can hardly be said to mean keeping company for a hundred years.
The Huangjin Ce says: with Wealth lines upon Wealth lines, one becomes a bridegroom anew.

I have tried it many times: when the man's family divines about the woman and the Wealth line is doubled, strong, and generates or combines with the Self line, it mostly means a virtuous wife and a fair concubine;
where Wealth changes into Wealth, it may answer as taking two brides, or as a maid or concubine coming along, or as many wives and concubines, or as a rich dowry.
Only beware a moving Peer line among the lines, or the Day and Month clashing and controlling the Wealth line; then the flower-candles of weddings, repeated, cannot be avoided.

When the woman's family divines about the man and gets Wealth changing into Wealth, with doubled Wealth lines generating the Self, it surely means a hundred taels filling the door and a thousand in gold as betrothal gifts; it is not good if Pressure moves and changes into Pressure, which surely means the husband's death, and when doubled Pressure lines control the Self, if it is not a fight over the marriage or a snatched bride it will be repeated disaster and dispute.
If a man divining meets this, it too means change, and where it controls the Self one should stop at once;
if the Self line changes into Pressure, one should stop all the more.

dispute.yi: 《黄金策》：财爻叠叠，重作新人（再娶，见 LY.MARRY.HJC.24）。野鹤说不一定是两次婚姻：他屡次试过，财爻重叠、财化财多是贤妻美妾、双娶、婢妾同来或妆奁丰厚；只有兄弟爻动、或日月冲克财爻的时候，再办喜事才免不了。
dispute.en: The Huangjin Ce: with Wealth lines upon Wealth lines, one becomes a bridegroom anew (remarriage; see LY.MARRY.HJC.24). The author says it is not necessarily two marriages: in his many trials, doubled Wealth or Wealth changing into Wealth mostly meant a virtuous wife and fair concubine, two brides, a maid or concubine coming along, or a rich dowry; only when a Peer line moves, or the Day and Month clash and control Wealth, can the repeated wedding not be avoided.

units.title: 兄临玄武防劫骗，鬼临白虎遇凶丧：兄鬼动临玄武防局中奸诈骗财，世应相生财官无害也要大破费；鬼临白虎动，未过门或过门不久必见丧事

rule.yi: 兄弟爻带玄武，要防被劫、被骗；鬼爻带白虎，会遇到凶丧之事。兄弟爻、鬼爻动而带玄武，要防局中有人奸诈骗钱，即使世应相生、财官无害，也要大破费。鬼爻带白虎而动，或是还没过门，或是过门不久，一定见丧事。
rule.en: A Peer line with the Dark Tortoise: beware of robbery and cheating; a Pressure line with the White Tiger: you will meet a death. When a Peer or Pressure line moves with the Dark Tortoise, beware of a treacherous scheme to cheat you of money; even if the Self and Other lines generate each other and Wealth and Pressure are unharmed, there will still be great expense. A moving Pressure line with the White Tiger means that, whether before she has entered the house or not long after, a funeral will surely be seen.

zh: 兄临玄武防劫骗，鬼临白虎遇凶丧。
兄鬼动临玄武，防局中奸诈骗财，纵使世应相生，财官无害，亦须大费。
鬼临虎动，或未过门，或过门不久，必见丧事。
yi: 兄弟爻带玄武要防被劫、被骗，鬼爻带白虎会遇到凶丧之事。
兄弟爻、鬼爻动而临玄武，要防局中有人奸诈骗钱，即使世应相生、财官无害，也要大破费。
鬼爻临白虎而动，或是还没过门，或是过门不久，一定见丧事。
en: A Peer line with the Dark Tortoise: beware of robbery and cheating; a Pressure line with the White Tiger: you will meet with a death in the family.

When a Peer or Pressure line moves with the Dark Tortoise, beware of a treacherous scheme to cheat you of money; even if the Self and Other generate each other and Wealth and Pressure are unharmed, there will still be great expense.
A moving Pressure line with the White Tiger: whether before she has entered the house or not long after, a funeral will surely be seen.

units.title: 应财世鬼夫唱妇随，应鬼世财夫权妻夺：世持鬼应持财是阴阳得位，鬼临应财持世是牝鸡司晨，惟赘婿反吉

rule.yi: 应爻是财、世爻是鬼，夫唱妇随；应爻是鬼、世爻是财，丈夫的权被妻子夺走。世爻持鬼、应爻持财，叫阴阳得位，夫妻必定和谐；鬼在应爻、财在世爻，一定是母鸡司晨，妻子夺了丈夫的权。只有入赘的女婿得到这样的卦反而吉。
rule.en: The Other line as Wealth and the Self line as Pressure: the husband leads and the wife follows; the Other line as Pressure and the Self line as Wealth: the wife takes the husband's authority. The Self line holding Pressure and the Other line holding Wealth is called yin and yang in their places, and the couple will surely be in harmony; Pressure on the Other line and Wealth on the Self line is surely the hen crowing at dawn, the wife seizing the husband's authority. Only for a son-in-law who marries into the wife's family is this, on the contrary, auspicious.

zh: 应财世鬼，夫唱妇随；
应鬼世财，夫权妻夺。
世持鬼，应持财，谓之阴阳得位，必然鸾凤齐鸣；
鬼临应，财持世，定是牝鸡司晨，妻夺夫权。
惟赘婿得之反吉。
yi: 应爻是财、世爻是鬼，夫唱妇随；
应爻是鬼、世爻是财，夫权被妻夺走。
世爻持鬼，应爻持财，叫作阴阳得位，必定夫妻和鸣；
鬼临应爻，财持世爻，一定是母鸡司晨，妻子夺了丈夫的权。
只有入赘的女婿得到这样的卦反而吉。
en: The Other line as Wealth and the Self line as Pressure: the husband leads and the wife follows;
the Other line as Pressure and the Self line as Wealth: the wife takes the husband's authority.
The Self line holding Pressure and the Other line holding Wealth is called yin and yang in their places, and the phoenixes will surely sing in harmony;
Pressure on the Other line and Wealth on the Self line is surely the hen crowing at dawn, the wife seizing the husband's authority.
Only for a son-in-law who marries into the wife's family is this, on the contrary, auspicious.

units.chapter_en: Section on whether the marriage suits the parents
units.title: 此婚有宜于父母否：专以父母爻为用神，旺衰皆不忌，只忌财爻发动；财化父、父化财、鬼化父、父动化墓绝空破及回头克、日月克父母，则此婚有妨

rule.yi: 问这门婚事对父母好不好：专用父母爻做用神，父母爻旺也好、衰也好，都不忌；所忌的是财爻发动，那就一定是这门婚事有妨碍。比如财化父母、父母化财、鬼化父母、父母爻动而化成墓、绝、空、破，以及回头克，动而破散，或者日月克父母爻，那是父母暮年的时候了，就算不成这门婚事，也是难免的。
rule.en: Whether the marriage suits the parents: take the Resource line alone as the Subject; whether the Resource line is strong or weak is no matter, what is feared is a moving Wealth line, which surely means the marriage is harmful. For example Wealth changing into Resource, Resource changing into Wealth, Pressure changing into Resource, Resource moving and changing into tomb, extinction, Void or break, or into something that controls it, moving and then broken or scattered, or the Day or Month controlling the Resource line: this is the autumn of the parents' twilight years, and even if this marriage is not made it cannot be avoided.

zh: 专以父母为用神，父母或旺或衰，皆所不忌，所忌者，财爻发动，必此婚之有妨也。
如财化父、父化财、鬼化父、父动化墓绝空破，及回头克，动而破散，或日月克父母，乃桑榆暮景之秋，不成此婚亦难免也。
yi: 专以父母爻为用神，父母爻旺也好衰也好，都不忌，所忌的是财爻发动，那就一定是这门婚事有妨碍。
比如财化父母、父母化财、鬼化父母、父母爻动而化墓、绝、空、破，以及回头克，动而破散，或者日月克父母爻，那是父母暮年的时候了，就算不成这门婚事，也是难免的。
en: Take the Resource line alone as the Subject; whether the Resource line is strong or weak is no matter; what is feared is a moving Wealth line, which surely means the marriage is harmful.

For example Wealth changing into Resource, Resource changing into Wealth, Pressure changing into Resource, Resource moving and changing into tomb, extinction, Void or break, or into something that controls it, moving and then broken or scattered, or the Day or Month controlling the Resource line: this is the autumn of the parents' twilight years, and even if this marriage is not made it cannot be avoided.

note.yi: 原文最后一句「不成此婚亦难免也」含糊：可以读作「父母暮年之事，不成婚也躲不开」；这里照字面译，没有添补。这一节后面的「乾按」是后人加的，不引。
note.en: The last clause 'even if the marriage is not made it cannot be avoided' is terse and could be read as 'a matter of the parents' old age that cannot be dodged even without the match'; it is translated literally without filling in. The 'Qian note' after this section is a later addition and is not quoted.

units.title: 纳宠（娶妾）：为子嗣的用子孙爻，同占子嗣；否则专看财爻，同占婚

rule.yi: 娶妾：为了子嗣的，用子孙爻做用神，和前面占子嗣一样断；不是为了子嗣的，专看财爻，和占婚一样断。
rule.en: Taking a concubine: if it is for the sake of an heir, take the Output line as the Subject and judge as in the earlier divination on children; otherwise look at the Wealth line alone and judge as in a marriage divination.

zh: 为子嗣者，以子孙为用神，与前占子嗣同断，否则专看财爻，与占婚同断。
yi: 为了子嗣的，用子孙爻做用神，和前面占子嗣一样断，不然就专看财爻，和占婚一样断。
en: If it is for the sake of an heir, take the Output line as the Subject and judge as in the earlier divination on children; otherwise look at the Wealth line alone and judge as in a marriage divination.

note.yi: 这一节后面的「乾按」是后人加的，不引。
note.en: The 'Qian note' after this section is a later addition and is not quoted.

units.chapter_en: Section on taking on a servant
units.title: 配仆：财爻为用；财爻持世或动而生合世、化进化生、财化财，得忠诚出力之人；散破绝空非懒即病；克世冲世忘恩负义；化鬼化绝化墓化克及鬼化财，贫穷夭折

rule.yi: 配仆（安排仆人）：以财爻为用神。财爻持世，或者动了来生合世爻，或者动而化进神、化生，或者财化财，都会得到忠诚肯出力的人；财爻散、破、绝、空，不是懒就是病；财爻克世、冲世，是忘恩负义的人；财爻化成鬼、绝、墓、克，以及鬼爻化成财爻，是贫穷短命之类的人。
rule.en: Taking on a servant: the Wealth line is the Subject. With the Wealth line on the Self line, or moving to generate or combine with the Self line, or moving and changing into an Advancing spirit or a generator, or Wealth changing into Wealth, you gain someone loyal who serves with effort; if the Wealth line is scattered, broken, extinguished or Void, the person is either lazy or ill; if the Wealth line controls or clashes with the Self line, the person betrays kindness and forgets favors; if Wealth changes into Pressure, extinction, tomb or a controller, or Pressure changes into Wealth, the person is of the poor and short-lived sort.

zh: 财爻为用。
财爻持世，或动而生合世爻，动而化进化生，财化财，皆得忠诚效力；
散破绝空，非懒即病；
财爻克世、冲世，负义忘恩之辈；
财化鬼、化绝、化墓、化克，及鬼化财爻，贫穷夭折之流。
yi: 以财爻为用神。
财爻持世，或者动了来生合世爻，动而化进神、化生，财化财，都得到忠诚肯出力的人；
财爻散、破、绝、空，不是懒就是病；
财爻克世、冲世，是忘恩负义的人；
财爻化成鬼、化绝、化墓、化克，以及鬼爻化成财爻，是贫穷短命之类的人。
en: The Wealth line is the Subject.

With the Wealth line on the Self line, or moving to generate or combine with the Self line, or moving and changing into an Advancing spirit or into a generator, or Wealth changing into Wealth, you gain someone loyal who serves with effort;
if it is scattered, broken, extinguished or Void, the person is either lazy or ill;
if the Wealth line controls or clashes with the Self line, the person betrays kindness and forgets favors;
if Wealth changes into Pressure, extinction, tomb or a controller, or Pressure changes into Wealth, the person is of the poor and short-lived sort.

note.yi: 「配仆」原是婚姻章里的一小节（安排、聘用仆人），原书说它和婚姻看法一样（那句「乾按」是后人加的，不引）。收在这里是因为它排在婚姻章里，不是因为它是婚姻。
note.en: 'Taking on a servant' is a short section inside the marriage chapter. It is included here because it sits in the marriage chapter, not because it is about marriage. The 'Qian note' saying it is read like marriage is a later addition and is not quoted.

units.chapter_en: Section on taking a divorced woman or one who has left prostitution
units.title: 取离妇跳娼妇：防患者用子孙，防拦阻者看兄鬼；六冲变冲凶，三合六合吉；强夺婚、私约不祥不义，勿告神

rule.yi: 娶离了婚的妇人、或从娼门出来的妇人：要防祸患，用子孙爻——子孙持世、发动，没有忧患；财爻持世、子孙动来相生更吉；鬼爻或兄弟爻克世、随墓助伤、鬼爻持世，婚事虽成，祸患跟着生；财爻克世、兄弟持世，是落进别人设的局，一定人财两空。要防有人拦阻：兄弟爻动就不成，鬼爻动就有祸。兄弟持世，到底难成；财爻动来相生，不用谋划就成。六冲变冲是凶，三合、六合的吉。六合变冲，成了不长久；六冲变合，最终一定成。强抢的婚事、私下的约定，既不吉祥也不合义，不要去告问神明。
rule.en: Marrying a woman who has left her husband, or one who has left the brothel: to guard against harm, use the Output line; with the Output line on the Self line or moving there is nothing to worry about; with the Wealth line on the Self line and a moving Output line generating it, better still; if Pressure or a Peer line controls the Self line, or there is following into a tomb or aiding of harm, or Pressure holds the Self line, although the marriage is made calamity follows; if Wealth controls the Self line and a Peer line holds it, you have fallen into someone's trap and will lose both the person and the money. To guard against obstruction: if a Peer line moves it will not succeed, and if Pressure moves there will be disaster. With a Peer line on the Self line it is in the end hard to accomplish; with Wealth moving to generate, it comes about without scheming. A Six-clash changing into a clash is ill, a three-harmony or Six-combine is auspicious; a Six-combine changing into a clash is made but does not last, a Six-clash changing into a combine will surely succeed in the end. Forcing a marriage or fulfilling a secret pact is neither auspicious nor righteous; do not put it to the spirits.

zh: 防患者，用子孙。
子孙持世，子孙发动，无忧也；
财爻持世，子动相生者，更吉；
鬼兄克世、随墓助伤、鬼爻持世，婚姻虽就，祸患随生；
财克世，兄持世，落人之局，必人财两失。
防拦阻者，兄动不成，鬼动有祸。
兄爻持世，到底难成；
财动相生，不谋而就。
六冲变冲为凶，三合六合者吉。
六合变冲，成而不久；
六冲变合，终必有成。
强夺婚、遂私约，非祥非义，勿告于神。
yi: 要防患的，用子孙爻。
子孙持世，子孙发动，就没有忧患；
财爻持世，子孙动来相生的，更吉；
鬼爻、兄弟爻克世，随墓、助伤，或者鬼爻持世，婚事虽然成了，祸患随之而生；
财爻克世，兄弟爻持世，是落进别人设的局，一定人财两空。
要防有人拦阻的，兄弟爻动就不成，鬼爻动就有祸。
兄弟爻持世，到底难成；
财爻动来相生，不用谋划就成。
六冲变成冲是凶，三合、六合的吉。
六合变成冲，成了也不长久；
六冲变成合，最终一定成。
强抢婚事、成全私下的约定，既不吉祥也不合义，不要去告问神明。
en: To guard against harm, use the Output line.
With the Output line on the Self line or moving, there is nothing to worry about;
with the Wealth line on the Self line and a moving Output line generating it, it is better still;
if Pressure or a Peer line controls the Self line, or there is following into a tomb or aiding of harm, or Pressure holds the Self line, although the marriage is made calamity follows;
if Wealth controls the Self line and a Peer line holds it, you have fallen into someone's trap and will lose both the person and the money.
To guard against obstruction: if a Peer line moves it will not succeed; if Pressure moves there will be disaster.
With a Peer line on the Self line, in the end it is hard to accomplish;
with Wealth moving to generate, it comes about without scheming.
A Six-clash changing into a clash is ill; a three-harmony or Six-combine is auspicious.
A Six-combine changing into a clash: made but not lasting;
a Six-clash changing into a combine will surely succeed in the end.
Forcing a marriage or fulfilling a secret pact is neither auspicious nor righteous; do not put it to the spirits.

note.yi: 章名「取离妇跳娼妇」里的「跳」字含义不确定（可能是脱籍、赎身，也可能是别的），别的书里没有同名的章可对；译文按「从娼门出来的妇人」取，不敢说得更死。这一节末尾还有一句「出妾休妻，原非所欲，有不得已而出者，必去难留」，像是下一节的开头，没有收。
note.en: The word 'tiao' ('to leap') in the section title is uncertain (it may mean leaving the trade, being bought out, or something else) and no other book has a section of the same name; it is translated as a woman who has left prostitution without claiming more. The section ends with the sentence 'Sending away a concubine or wife is not what one wants...', which looks like the start of the next section and is not included.

units.title: 占婚不要求容貌才情十全：官占长生、财落墓库近理，以八宫推容貌、六神定才情不可；用财官兼世应断足矣

rule.yi: 李我平批评古法占婚多浮辞：《黄金策》说的「丈夫有才能，官鬼占长生的位置；妻子丑拙，财爻落在墓库」还算近理；《易冒》用八宫推容貌、用六神定才情就不行——同一卦，按八宫读是端正聪明的淑女，按六神读财爻临白虎又成了悖逆之星，两种读法彼此打架。婚姻有一定的缘分，财旺官兴，就会夫唱妇随；相生相合，自然有讨人喜欢的容貌；吉的就求，凶的就弃，用财、官兼看世、应来断就够了。要是事事求全——命不入墓、六亲不相妨、父母不沉、子孙不溺、财不动、官不没、夫妇不二、阴阳不悖——世上没有这样的女子，六十四卦里也没有这样的卦。
rule.en: Li Woping criticizes the old methods of divining marriage as full of showy words: what the Huangjin Ce says, that a husband with ability has the Pressure line in the position of Birth and an ugly, clumsy wife has the Wealth line in the tomb or storehouse, is still close to reason; but the Yi Mao inferring looks from the eight palaces and settling talent by the six spirits will not do, since the same hexagram read by palace gives an upright and clever virtuous woman, and read by spirit gives Wealth with the White Tiger, a star of perversity, so the two readings contradict each other. Marriage has its appointed bond: with Wealth strong and Pressure flourishing, husband leads and wife follows; where they generate and combine she will naturally have looks that please; seek what is auspicious and abandon what is ill, and judging by Wealth and Pressure together with the Self and Other lines is enough. If one demands perfection in everything (fates not entering a tomb, six kin not harming each other, parents not sinking, children not lost, Wealth not moving, Pressure not lost, no second spouse, yin and yang not at odds), there is no such woman in the world and no such hexagram among the sixty-four.

zh: 李我平曰：古法占婚，不言正理，多尚浮辞，议论多而凭据少，不知先贤何以指人之迷也？
《黄金策》曰：夫若才能，官占长生之位；
妻如丑拙，财落墓库之乡。
此犹近理。
《易冒》以八宫而推容貌，六神而定才情，则不可也。
假令卯月戊日，得“否”卦，旺财持世，推容貌以八宫者，此卦财在乾宫，乾为天，谓仪容端正，性质聪明，配天德之淑女也。
然财临白虎，若兼六神而断，白虎乃悖逆之星，成婚之后，配天德之良女而悖逆者，未之有也，是以容貌才情，无事卜之，岂不闻在德不在色。
婚姻有一定之缘，财旺官兴，定遂唱随之好；
相生相合，自有悦己之容，吉者求之，凶者弃之，用财官兼世应而断足矣。
必欲两命不宜入墓、六亲俱不相妨、父母不可沦、子孙不可溺、财爻不宜动、官鬼不宜没、夫妇勿二、阴阳莫悖，事事求全，不惟世无此十全之女，即六十四卦之中，亦无此十全之卦也，浮辞欺世，实误后人。
yi: 李我平说：古法占婚，不讲正理，多崇尚浮华的话，议论多而凭据少，不知先贤靠什么来指点人的迷惘？
《黄金策》说：丈夫如果有才能，官鬼爻占长生的位置；
妻子如果丑陋笨拙，财爻落在墓库的位置。
这还算近乎道理。
《易冒》用八宫来推容貌，用六神来定才情，那就不行了。
假如卯月戊日，得否卦，旺相的财爻持世，用八宫推容貌的，这一卦财在乾宫，乾为天，就说仪容端正、性情聪明，配得上天德的贤淑女子。
可是财爻临白虎，如果再兼顾六神来断，白虎是悖逆之星，成婚以后，配得上天德的好女子而悖逆的，从来没有的事；所以容貌才情，不必去卜它，难道没听说过重德不重色吗。
婚姻有一定的缘分，财旺官兴，一定遂夫唱妇随的美好；
相生相合，自然有悦己的容貌，吉的就求，凶的就弃，用财、官兼看世应来断就够了。
如果一定要两人的命不能入墓、六亲都不相妨、父母不可沉沦、子孙不可沉溺、财爻不宜动、官鬼不宜没、夫妇不可有二、阴阳不可悖乱，事事求全，不但世上没有这样十全的女子，就是六十四卦之中，也没有这样十全的卦，浮辞欺世，实在是耽误后人。
en: Li Woping says: the old methods of divining marriage do not speak of the right principle; they mostly favor showy words, with much argument and little evidence; I do not know how the worthies of the past thought to guide people out of their confusion.
The Huangjin Ce says: if the husband has ability, the Pressure line takes the position of Birth (Changsheng);
if the wife is ugly and clumsy, the Wealth line falls in the place of tomb and storehouse.
This is still close to reason.
But the Yi Mao infers looks from the eight palaces and settles talent and temperament by the six spirits, which will not do.

Suppose in a Mao month on a Wu day one obtains Pi, with a strong Wealth line on the Self line; for those who infer looks from the eight palaces, this hexagram has Wealth in the Qian palace, Qian is Heaven, so they say her bearing is upright, her nature clever, a virtuous woman matched to Heaven's virtue.

But the Wealth line is with the White Tiger, and if one also judges by the six spirits, the White Tiger is the star of perversity; after the wedding, a fine woman matched to Heaven's virtue who turns perverse has never been; so looks and talent need no divination: have you not heard that what counts is virtue, not beauty?
Marriage has its appointed bond: with Wealth strong and Pressure flourishing, the good of husband leading and wife following will surely be fulfilled;

where they generate and combine, she will naturally have looks that please; seek what is auspicious and abandon what is ill; judging by Wealth and Pressure together with the Self and Other lines is enough.

If one insists that neither of the two fates enter a tomb, that all six kin do not harm each other, that the parents (the Resource line) not sink, that the children (the Output line) not be lost, that Wealth not move, that Pressure not be lost, that there be no second spouse, and that yin and yang not be at odds, demanding perfection in everything, then not only is there no such perfect woman in the world, but among the sixty-four hexagrams there is no such perfect hexagram; showy words deceive the world and truly mislead later generations.
